name: com.gameframex.unity.entity
description:
GameFrameX Entity — Unity entity management package. Manages showing, hiding, grouping and parent-child attachment of game entities (attach by transform path or reference) with async spawning returning Task<IEntity>, entity groups with pooled instance capacity / expire time / auto-release interval, per-entity locking and priority, and event notifications across the show / hide lifecycle. Startup moves to code-level EntityOptions (GameFrameXOptions.Configure: capacity, expire time, helper factories, real-time event toggles). Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Entity — Unity 实体管理功能包。管理游戏实体的显示、隐藏、分组与父子挂接（按 Transform 路径或引用挂接），异步生成返回 Task<IEntity>；实体组具备池化实例容量/过期时间/自动释放间隔，支持实体级锁定与优先级，并提供显示/隐藏全生命周期事件通知。启动配置收敛为代码级 EntityOptions（GameFrameXOptions.Configure：容量、过期时间、Helper 工厂、实时事件开关）。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
